verdict.rationale: Vast.ai exposes CLI, REST API, and SDK for full instance lifecycle management (search, create, connect, destroy) plus billing/autobilling to avoid paying when not running, and scoped API keys for CI/CD automation. Community evidence corroborates the CLI-driven workflow (search offers, rent, connect, clean up) though it also notes reliability variance. missing for 10: explicit documented start/stop/restart CLI commands (only create/destroy/search shown), and independent hands-on confirmation of stop/restart billing behavior.
